en.title: Song Preference Ranking
en.description:
One song beats another if more than half of the users prefer the former, or exactly half do and the former has the smaller id. A song's popularity is the number of songs it beats.

This site's standard input/output protocol and the supplementary limits noted in the statement are this site's judging conventions; they do not imply that the original OA platform provided the same protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n m (1≤n,m≤200), followed by n lines, each a permutation of 0..m−1 listing one user's songs from most to least preferred.
en.output: Output the song ids sorted by the number of songs beaten in descending order, with the smaller id first on ties, separated by spaces.
en.explanation: See the accompanying solution for the approach, the proof of correctness, and the complexity.
